name: Where is the best place to position a refrigerator in a kitchen layout?

mainEntity.name: Where is the best place to position a refrigerator in a kitchen layout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Refrigerator placement must account for full door-swing clearances, walking paths, and proximity to adjacent counters. Place the refrigerator along an outer edge of the kitchen so household members can grab beverages and snacks without walking through active cooking zones. Avoid placing a refrigerator tight against a corner wall; doors require extra hinge clearance to open past 90 degrees so interior crisper drawers can fully slide out. Additionally, ensure there is a clear landing counter—at least 15 to 18 inches wide—immediately adjacent to or directly across from the refrigerator for setting down groceries.
acceptedAnswer.description: Place the refrigerator at the perimeter edge of the kitchen with nearby landing counter space, ensuring doors clear adjacent walls to fully open drawers.
